research_question: Can a provenance-blind optimizer reconstruct a target C2/SCFA context signature from controllable context variables while minimizing matrix complexity?

objective.symbolic: M* = argmin_M D(Phi(acetate + M), Phi(reference_context)) + lambda * complexity(M)
objective.implemented_self_test_distance: weighted squared Euclidean distance on dimensionless synthetic proxies

search_space.acetate: fixed canonical species; source lineage excluded from optimization features

synthetic_self_test.purpose: Verify optimizer mechanics and anti-bias invariants only; not a physiological result.
synthetic_self_test.expected: best candidate should reproduce the synthetic reference except where an explicit complexity penalty creates a declared tradeoff

evidence_bindings.claim: Engineering A. pasteurianus can change acetic-acid productivity without implying a new acetate molecular species.
evidence_bindings.note: adhA + pqqABCDE average productivity reported 32% above parental strain.

evidence_bindings.claim: Colonic-administered acetate has route/microbiota-dependent systemic and cross-feeding behavior.
evidence_bindings.note: 12 healthy subjects; 36 ± 21% systemic availability; acetate->butyrate interconversion about 24%; special colon-delivery design.

evidence_bindings.claim: Kombucha fermentation composition is dynamic and requires microbial/process quality control.
evidence_bindings.note: 2024 fermentation study reported dynamic metabolites including biogenic amines.

evidence_bindings.claim: Genetic programming of bacterial-cellulose-producing Komagataeibacter is experimentally established.

claim_ceiling: No result here establishes a human feeding strategy, medical treatment, safety, efficacy or dosage.
No wet-lab genetic-engineering protocol is provided.
The synthetic target is not a healthy-human target and must never be interpreted as one.
Future biological parameterization requires primary data, explicit uncertainty and external review.
